prompt: Create an original 150 second Japanese acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: koto, shakuhachi, soft hand drum. Style: sparse plucked phrases and gentle breathy flute, no voice. Tempo approximately 64 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A serene and meditative instrumental piece featuring traditional East Asian-inspired melodies played on bowed strings, plucked strings, and flute. The music evokes a sense of calm and introspection.
description.zh: 一首宁静而富有冥想感的纯音乐，以弓弦乐器、弹拨乐器和长笛演奏出具有东亚风格的旋律。音乐营造出一种平静和内省的氛围。
